notes:
Live sync stops waiting on your cursor, first sync shows real progress, block ordering gets self-healing, and two visible annoyances are fixed.

**New**

- **First sync shows real progress (dev).** Connecting a device now shows "Downloading your notes… 12,500 of 86,000" ticking live per batch instead of a static "this can take a few minutes" note, and an interrupted first sync says plainly "First sync paused — it resumes automatically." (PRD Addendum 25 §W7 completed on desktop; #639.)

**Fixes & polish**

- **Sync updates arrive around your cursor, not after it.** While you type, a sync that changes other parts of the open note now applies those parts **immediately** — only the exact block your cursor is in waits for a ~1-second pause. Previously the entire incoming batch waited whenever any part of it touched your cursor block. Your caret and scroll position stay put while the rest of the note updates. (PRD Addendum 27 §X, single-range granularity; #640.)
- **Selecting text in a code block is visible again.** Selections inside code blocks were being painted *behind* the code block's background — invisible, though the toolbar knew they existed. They now paint on a translucent layer above the code, in every theme, light and dark. (PRD Addendum 23 §V7 never-invisible rule; fixes #636; #641.)
- **The formatting toolbar no longer follows you to other tabs.** Switching tabs with a selection active used to leave the B/I/U toolbar floating over the new tab until you went back and clicked. It now hides when its tab is hidden and returns — selection intact — when you come back. (Fixes #637; #641.)
- **Block ordering can no longer wear out.** Repeatedly inserting lines at the same spot could exhaust the fractional ordering keys' precision, eventually making new lines land in arbitrary order. The app now detects a crowded region and re-spaces it before inserting — a one-time, sync-converging renumber per region. (PRD Addendum 26 §9 rebalance rule; #638.)

**Under the hood**

- Live-sync partial application segments the block-diff at hot-node boundaries with the whole-batch deferral retained as the conservative fallback (hot moves/reparents, ambiguous resurrect anchors); the deferred flush re-reads current state so the newest LWW outcome always wins. (#640.)
- The sort-key rebalance triggers below an absolute + magnitude-relative gap floor, renumbers the crowded run to standard 1024 spacing, and emits ordinary per-block sort ops — convergence proven in the sync simulator (72/72 incl. concurrent-rebalance races). (#638.)
- Code-block selection bands render on a new above-content veil layer using a `--color-selection-veil` token derived for all 7 themes; the floating toolbar's visibility is gated by an IntersectionObserver on its own editor + window focus — event-driven, no polling. (#641.)
- First-sync progress rides a new per-batch `sync:progress` event on desktop (counts only, Privacy-Invariant clean); the parked-op reapply still runs after the final batch. (#639.)
